title: Self-Jailbreaking Audit: Do Open Reasoning Models Verbalize Their Own Loophole-Finding?

original_idea.body: Single-demonstration many-shot defense breakdown (extends arXiv:2605.08277): reproduce single-anchor defense on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, sweep shot counts x anchor position, find the breakdown threshold curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Characterizing where a cheap many-shot defense fails is a concrete, deployment-relevant safety chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two single-GPU 7-8B models, shot-count x position grid, refusal-rate measurement; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped breakdown-threshold curve with clear conditions.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-weight, inference-only defense characterization labs deprioritize; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Source proposes the defense but not the breakdown curve; likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Breakdown threshold of single-anchor defense uncharacterized.
